lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg12V2 (reduced formula Mg6V) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows that both Mg and V centers adopt close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors each: Mg is surrounded by 8 Mg and 4 V neighbors, while V is coordinated by 12 Mg neighbors, with neighbor distances spanning roughly 3.04–3.23 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 14 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among 12-vertex Mg and V coordination polyhedra.
